title: National Key Laboratory of Advanced Pulp and Paper Technology and Materials, South China University of Technology
content: Aerogel National Laboratory. The National Key Laboratory of Advanced Pulp and Paper Technology and Materials at South China University of Technology is a national laboratory platform focused on advanced bio-based and paper-based materials. Its official research includes starch aerogels and porous-material development, making it relevant for lightweight aerogel-related innovation and technical research.
